items.label: Professional Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation
items.value: The Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling headphones reduce up to 33dB of noise so you can completely immerse into your rhythm whenever you need. Or if you need ambient sound, the Transparency Mode ensures you’re aware of your environment while you enjoy your music. There is a sensitive button control that makes it easy to switch between these two modes.

items.label: Premium Hi-Fi Music
items.value: With customized 40mm drivers, vibeadio Bluetooth noise canceling headphones shine through with thumping bass on the lows and crystal clarity on the highs, each beat to its very essence. Exhilarate your senses with details of musical experience. And latest Bluetooth V5.2 technology wirelessly streams high-quality sound from your Bluetooth devices without the messy cords.

items.label: Crystal Clear Hands-free Calls
items.value: Advanced microphone system precisely filters noise for crisp, clear call performance. These active noise cancelling headphones with ENC tech can catch your voice accurately and block background noise for perfect clear calls. Vibeadio wireless Bluetooth headphones make stable clear Hands-free calls which is convenient for home office/study.

items.label: Ultra Comfort and Lightweight
items.value: Enlarge breathable high-grade protein ear cushions softly surround the entire ears making you feel extremely comfortable that the total listening experience gets accentuated another level with vibeadio over ear Bluetooth headphones. Ergonomically designed and 30% lighter over-ear headphones provide an all-day comfortable experience.

items.label: Extended Long Playtime
items.value: Never worry about the shortage of power when you have long trips with compact lightweight vibeadio Bluetooth over ear headphones. Listen wirelessly for 30 hours without ANC and 25 hours with ANC on a single charge. Or use the provided detachable 3.5mm cable to listen even longer in wired mode when the battery is flat.

items.label: Built-In Media
items.value: Audio Line x 1, Charging Cable x 1, Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Headphones x 1, User Manual
